rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an unspecified, usually short period of time.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 zan6 sin1 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this when you want to state the duration more explicitly or suggest a longer stretch of time.

example.english: I lived abroad for a while.
example.traditional: 我喺外國住咗一段時間。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 ngoi6 gwok3 zyu6 zo2 jat1 dyun6 si4 gaan3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for saying that B happens during the time of A.

example.english: While I’m at work, help me look after the kid.
example.traditional: 我返工嗰陣，你幫我睇住個仔。
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan1 gung1 go2 zan6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 tai2 zyu6 go3 zai2

rows.note: Pick 雖然 for a concessive clause meaning that something is true despite what follows.

example.english: While it’s raining today, we’re still going hiking.
example.traditional: 雖然今日落雨，我哋都照去行山。
example.jyutping: seoi1 jin4 gam1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 dei6 dou1 ziu3 heoi3 haang4 saan1

rows.note: Pick 只要 when the meaning is a condition that is sufficient for the other clause.

example.english: While you’re willing to help, we can get everything sorted.
example.traditional: 只要你肯幫手，我哋就搞得掂。
example.jyutping: zi2 jiu3 nei5 hang2 bong1 sau2 ngo5 dei6 zau6 gaau2 dak1 dim6
